title: The AP/AR cross-cutting toggle is labeled 'View and Manage AP/AR Data'
custom_preconds:
1. You are logged in as an admin on Settings > Roles & Permissions.
  2. Open Create Role (or edit a custom role) so the permission cards are shown.
custom_steps:
1. Scroll to the Cross-Cutting Toggles card.
  2. Find the AP/AR toggle.
  3. Read its label.
custom_expected:
The Cross-Cutting Toggles card shows a toggle labeled 'View and Manage AP/AR Data'.

It sits alongside the 'See Financial Data' and 'View History Logs' toggles in the same card.

When ON, it controls the Unpaid Invoices, Payments and Credits tabs on customers and vendors, and the sensitive money fields on Edit Customer.
